scope: Android UI and protocol changes: voice diagnostic, immersive capture controls, 16:9 preview, camera clock sync
changed_contracts: More settings exposes a read-only voice API diagnostic; voice_* fields are never offered as writable controls.
Immersive monitor mode preserves mode selector, shutter and common parameter OSD while hiding system chrome.
Preview host surface follows 16:9 RTSP ratio and relayouts on orientation changes.
Camera clock sync sends msg2 type=camera_clock in local device time and verifies msg1 readback within two seconds.
limitations: No physical phone or camera acceptance in this run.
Stock 1.10.7 msg3/msg9 did not advertise voice_control; the app does not fabricate a setter or perform phone-side voice recognition.
Clock sync is explicit user action and only succeeds when the camera accepts the documented camera_clock write/readback contract.
